notes: Runtime processes load only the forecast representation used by that mode; exact complete world/runtime parity.

Forecast small: three predictions per child, two reversed-order rounds. Forecast large: one cold prediction per child, two reversed-order rounds. An exploratory three-prediction large child exceeded its resource/time envelope; the one-prediction workload completed in every mode.
Cold forecast equivalence covers all specified flow/path/contract/track/service/line-connection fields; timings and implementation telemetry are separate.
Node event-loop probes are not browser FPS; heap, ArrayBuffer, WASM and peak RSS are distinct measurements.

runtime-small.scope: Continuous operating core only: shared serialized world/forecast; 30 warmup + 5 x 30 game minutes; unchanged .1-minute quantum; current uses compact DTO; previous/JS receive equivalent full flows; excludes forecast, routing benchmarks, construction, DOM/map rendering and FPS
runtime-small.method: Eight independent processes; each loads only its own forecast representation; reversed order in round 2; exact complete state comparison, no excluded fields; forced GC outside timed batches
